title: GameTextField
responsibility: Preserve focused text drafts while reporting every keystroke for immediate unsaved-state tracking.

inputs.name: GameTextField.value
inputs.description: Committed display value used when the field is not focused.

inputs.name: GameTextField.change
inputs.description: Receives each raw text edit immediately, before blur or normalization.

inputs.name: GameTextField.label
inputs.description: Optional explicit accessible label; surrounding label content is otherwise used.

inputs.name: GameTextField.placeholder
inputs.description: Hint shown when the input has no text.

inputs.name: GameTextField.readonly
inputs.description: Prevent editing for immutable historical authoring views.

outputs.name: GameTextField
outputs.description: An accessible themed text input that preserves partial typed values until blur and reports edits immediately.
